question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

L _ _ RALMT _ _ _ _ TRALM_ R _
solution:
Given : L _ _ RALMT _ _ _ _ TRALM_ R _ 

By checking options :

 
• TRMALMTA → L __**T**__ __**R**__ RALMT __**M**__ __**A**__ __**L**__ __**M**__ TRALM__**T**__ R __**A**__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• MRTLAMTA → L __M__ __R__ RALMT __T__ __L__ __A__ __M__ TRALM__T__ R __A__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• MTRALMTA → L __M__ __T__ RALMT __R__ __A__ __L__ __M__ TRALM__T__ R __A__ → (It follows the pattern of : LMTRA - LMTRA - LMTRA - LMTRA)
 
• MTRLAMTA → L __M__ __T__ RALMT __R__ __L__ __A__ __M__ TRALM__T__ R __A__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (3) gives the pattern of "L __M__ __T__ RA - LMT __R__ __A__ - __L__ __M__ TRA - LM__T__ R __A__"

Hence, "**MTRALMTA**" is the correct answer.
